summary: Tested new /pesticide feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass in 71s including Coragen (EN), Roundup (HI, Devanagari verified), Mancozeb (MR), 400 validation (missing both, empty strings), and tiny-image fallback with generic safety info. Frontend: /pesticide page renders, both tabs swap correctly, name input + voice button + photo input + preview present, live Coragen lookup succeeds and displays product_name, category badge (insecticide), precautions, PPE, share and Save PDF buttons. Nav link (desktop + mobile) navigates correctly. Regression across /, /dashboard, /advisor, /pesticide, /calculator, /market, /profile — 0 console errors. Language dropdown still shows 6 languages.
critical_code_review_comments: pesticide_info.py fallback for banned_or_restricted uses False but schema allows string 'true'/'false' — minor: LLM may return string vs bool. Consumers should coerce.
Frontend PesticideInfo.jsx submits image_base64 as data URL (data:image/jpeg;base64,...); backend correctly strips via _strip_data_uri. OK.
db.pesticide_queries has no index; if the feature gains adoption consider (user_id, created_at desc) index similar to advisor_queries.
test_credentials: Not used — /api/pesticide/lookup is public. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required for this feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pesticide feature is stable. Real Claude Sonnet 5 calls cost tokens (~4 calls per full suite run, ~70s). Devanagari/regional-script validation for HI covered via regex [\u0900-\u097F]. Fake 32x32 JPEG path uses PIL if available else a bundled base64 fallback.
